Cc: Peter Cho <peter.cho@retailops.com>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP & Evaluation Plan — Redwood pilot

Thanks team — a few clarifying items as we pull together our procurement calendar.

Appreciate the draft MAP from last week; to finalize our internal approvals we need a firm timeline for:
- signature (DocuSign) cutoff so we can include the contract in May spend;
- target pilot start date (our ops lead prefers first week of June);
- evaluation success criteria so we can sign off at the end of the trial (latency SLA, throughput targets, and qualititative accuracy checks).

We will also require the SOC 2 report and SAML SSO details before we deploy to our staging VPC. I attached the RFP appendix with our internal checklist. Can you circulate an updated MAP that includes the legal/PO steps and a clear go/no-go gate?

Also looping in Peter from procurement — Peter, do you have any hard PO deadlines on your side?

Thanks,
Elena Novak
VP, Product Operations
Stellar Retail

Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP & Evaluation Plan — Redwood pilot

Elena — thanks for the clarity. Attached are two artifacts: MAP_v1.xlsx (mutual action plan with dates and owners) and EvalPlan.md (concrete test cases and pass/fail criteria). High level proposal below — please confirm and we will push the DocuSign envelope once legal gives the green light.

Proposed MAP highlights:
- May 18 — MAP circulated (this email)
- May 20 — Legal & PO review complete (target for redlines) — owner: Priyom Das
- May 21 — DocuSign sent (target EOD) — owner: Jonas Weber
- May 25 — Signed contract in place (target)
- Jun 1 — Pilot start (canary on subset of traffic)
- Jun 15 — Evaluation checkpoint (latency < 200ms p95, throughput target 150 qps sustained, quality A/B win >= 5% over baseline)
- Jun 30 — Final go/no-go decision based on combined ops & quality signals

Go/no-go gates (must all be met to proceed to production):
1) Security/compliance: SOC 2/SSO verification complete
2) Performance: p95 latency target and throughput validated on staging with representative load
3) Quality: evaluation set meets minimum acceptance thresholds in EvalPlan.md
4) Contract & billing terms final (PO or signed SOW)

Notes for you: we included a fallback window to move the DocuSign send to May 22 if Priyom requests more time for redlines. Rafael, can you confirm whether Stellar needs a PO before signature or whether a signature + PO within 30 days is acceptable?
